annotations.text:
GRIDIRON TERMINAL — hash marks as the structural motif
• faint yard-line + double-hash-row field behind the hero
• section eyebrows are yard markers (10 / 20 / 30) on a hash rule
• card headers + stat rows on a hash baseline
• EDGE METER is a real field — tinted end zones, two hash rows in from the sidelines, 50 at center, the ball spotted at +2.5 toward the player to start
Type: Barlow Condensed + Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono. Volt-lime accent <5%.

THIS WEEK — cues from ESPN / Yahoo / CBS / NFL
• field-styled matchup slider — ball shows Titans favored by 7.2
• 'Optimize lineup' with projected gain + win-prob delta
• 'Managers starting 58% · AXIS: bench' — model vs the crowd
• trending arrows, news line, position tags, per-player EDGE micro-field-bars
• right rail: swap + field meter, waiver + FAAB, game-time watch

LIGHT MODE — same structure, same layout, remapped palette
Page #F5F5F2, cards #FFFFFF, hairlines #E4E4DE. The top scoreboard bar and the AXIS mark stay BLACK in both modes — the broadcast anchor.
Accent splits: volt-lime #CDF03A stays the fill color (with near-black text); a deep turf green #4C7A00 does the work as accent INK — links, active tab, edge numbers, the ball — because pure lime is unreadable as text on white.
End-zone tint on the light field is a pale grass green #EDF3D6.
